LanguageData.GM21_TC_ChooseDesc: Choose one equipment recipe. A Crafting Grandmaster will gather its ingredients and the workstation’s catalyst, then permanently commit the project.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_DialogHelp: Choose a researched equipment recipe, then its material if needed. A Crafting Grandmaster will gather the ingredients and the workstation’s catalyst. Once committed, the project cannot be cancelled or refunded. Its 50% Magical outcome is revealed at completion.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Unavailable: Requires this workstation’s research, a usable workstation, and compatible ingredient APIs.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Idle: No project selected. Requires a Crafting Grandmaster.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Queued: Selected: {0}\nWaiting for a Crafting Grandmaster, ingredients and the workstation’s catalyst.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Missing: Missing accessible recipe ingredients or the workstation’s catalyst.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_NoDeconstruct: Committed projects cannot be deconstructed. Destroying this workstation loses the project and its ingredients.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Faulted: Project paused: saved data or a mod callback needs attention. See Player.log. No resources will be refunded or rerolled.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_OutputWaiting: Finished item retained inside workstation. Clear space nearby for delivery.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Recovery: Uncommitted ingredients retained after a failed start. Clear space nearby and recover them before choosing another project.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_DialogHelpTiers: Ceiling: {0}. Requires one {1} plus the recipe ingredients. Only a Crafting Grandmaster can commit and work. No cancellation or refund after commitment. Lower-tier or ordinary Legendary outcomes are possible.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Cooldown: Cooldown after manifestation: {0} ticks (~{1} seconds at 1×)
LanguageData.GM21_TC_TriggerSafety: Triggers on a damaging hit against a standing hostile, including a hit that downs or kills it. Allies and colony prisoners are protected. Damage shown is before armor.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_ChainLightning: Arcs through up to {0} hostile pawns, at most {1} cells per jump. Decreasing electrical damage: {2}.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_Smite: Strikes up to {1} hostile pawns within {0} cells of impact for {2} blunt damage each. Buildings and terrain are unharmed.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_FlameWave: Burns up to {1} hostile pawns within {0} cells of impact for {2} heat damage each. Does not ignite fires.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_FrostNova: Chills up to {1} hostile pawns within {0} cells. Movement speed ×{2} for {3} ticks. Does not stack or refresh existing frost.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_GravityCrush: Deals {0} bonus blunt damage to the primary hostile, then stuns it for {1} ticks if still standing. Skips an unavailable primary.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_VampiricStrike: Deals {0} bonus stab damage. Heals {1}% of actual bonus damage, up to {2}; if the triggering hit already downed or killed the victim, uses its actual damage instead. Regenerating restores another {3}%, up to {4} total over {5} ticks (~{6} seconds at 1×). Highest-severity ordinary wounds first; no scars, diseases or missing-part restoration. Repeated bursts refresh duration and keep the larger remaining budget.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_Effect_SpatialSlash: Deals {0} cut damage with {3}% armor penetration to the primary hostile; may strike one secondary within {2} cells for {1}. Skips unavailable targets. No teleportation.
LanguageData.GM21_TC_RegenRemaining: Remaining wound-healing budget: {0}. Highest-severity nonpermanent injuries first.
